question: how many cases survive a generator change at the same seed — i.e. whether 'same seed, same size' gives paired samples across generator versions
reading: a case is built from a random.Random seeded on (seed, index); every draw advances that stream, so a generator change that ADDS a draw re-randomises every case after it. Fixing the seed does not fix the sample, and a before/after comparison over these two runs is not paired.
